decisions.reason: The existing message-701 MODIFY already captures preservation of accumulated Small Block ticket eligibility through safe redeployment; no additional change is required.
The existing message-701 MODIFY already requires prize-pool and next-draw displays to use the retained production draw state.
The existing message-701 MODIFY already captures retention of production mint counts and numbering through safe redeployment.
The existing message-701 MODIFY already captures preservation of existing NFTs and their referral, ticket, badge, and reward metadata.
Preserving live prize state during contract redeployment does not change the required FAQ explanations or product mechanics described there.
The existing message-701 MODIFY already requires retained production NFTs to remain visible on the connected user's dashboard.
The safe-redeployment decision changes production-state continuity, not the About page's informational copy.
Retaining prize-pool and draw state does not change no-referral trigger, recipient-selection, reward, or first-mint rules.
The source decision does not change ticket issuance, expiration, or reset rules; preservation of accumulated eligibility is already represented by the winner-selection continuity requirement.
Safe redeployment and Small Block draw-state retention do not alter secondary-sale royalty amounts, enforcement, marketplace policy, or pool destination.
The source decision preserves existing production state but does not change the $15 primary-mint allocation among the founder, affiliate, and Small Block pool.
The existing message-701 MODIFY already records safe redeployment while retaining users, NFTs, and current production data; the legacy-contract policy remains compatible and unchanged.
